changedRows.sourceText: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before the LORD, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

unresolvedMentions.reasonJa: 明記された集団だが適合する既存IDなし。

changedRows.reasonJa: 21:8で名を挙げる7人が処刑された/その遺体について述べる。AdrielとMerabは5人の親であり、7人の処刑対象そのものではない。Davidも当節の指示対象ではない。

changedRows.sourceText: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.
changedRows.reasonJa: 21:8で名を挙げる7人が処刑された/その遺体について述べる。AdrielとMerabは5人の親であり、7人の処刑対象そのものではない。Davidも当節の指示対象ではない。

changedRows.sourceText: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.
changedRows.reasonJa: heはDavid。SaulとJonathanは直名。those who were hangedには21:8–9で名を挙げたArmoniとMephiboshethが含まれるためcontextで記録。

changedRows.sourceText: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.
changedRows.reasonJa: Ishbi-benobの名はこの節で明記される。sons of the giantも明示され、匿名の先祖をthe giant profileで記録するが実名は補わない。

changedRows.sourceText: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”
changedRows.reasonJa: the Philistineは前節で名指しされたIshbi-benob。Abishai/David/Israel/Zeruiahは本文に明記。

changedRows.sourceText: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
changedRows.reasonJa: Sibbecai the HushathiteとSaph、Gobは明記。Saphはsons of the giantの一人。Davidはこの節に名も照応もなく、背景リンクを除く。

changedRows.sourceText: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

unresolvedMentions.reasonJa: 固定WEBはElhananの父をJaare-Oregimと記す。既存Jair IDとの同一性を本文から確認できない。

changedRows.reasonJa: ElhananがGoliath the Gittite’s brotherを殺したと明記。Goliathの名前は兄弟関係で言及されるのでdirectだが、殺された人物は兄弟でありGoliath本人ではない。Gittite/BethlehemiteはGath/Bethlehem由来の直接呼称。Davidとgiant祖先はこの節にない。

changedRows.sourceText: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.
changedRows.reasonJa: Gathとman of great statureは明記。「born to the giant」は匿名の先祖を明示的に指すのでdirect。Davidは当節に名/照応がなく除去。

changedRows.sourceText: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.

excludedCandidates.reasonJa: WEB says Jonathan son of Shimeah; Jonadab is another person.

unresolvedMentions.reasonJa: 一致する既存IDなし。Jonadab候補は別人。

changedRows.reasonJa: Jonathan son of ShimeiがIsraelを侮辱した巨人を殺す。he=匿名Jonathan（適合IDなし）、himは21:20のman of great stature。Davidは兄弟として明記。Jonadabは別人なのでリンクしない。

changedRows.sourceText: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

unresolvedMentions.reasonJa: 21:19でElhananが殺した匿名の兄弟が「these four」の一人。個人IDがなく、Goliath本人やgiant ancestorとは区別して未同定のまま残す。

changedRows.reasonJa: these fourは21:16,18–21に出る巨人の子らをまとめて指す。the giantは本文で親として明示されるが、個人名は判明しない。GathとDavidも明記。

notesJa: 21:9/10は親Adriel/Merabと匿名の処刑対象を区別。21:19はGoliathの名を直接記録しながら殺害対象を匿名の兄弟と区別し、Gittite/Bethlehemiteを地名派生として追加。the giantは匿名祖先として明記される節だけdirect。Jonathan son of Shimei、Jaare-Oregim等は適合/同一性が確かでないため保留。
